description: Replacing the free names of a formula by corresponding new constants preserves exactly the occurrences of its original nonlogical symbols.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CraigInterpolation.name_symbols.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (A : L.Formula α) (s : L.Symbols) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CraigInterpolation.originalSymbol α s ∈
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.equivSentence A) ↔
    s ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols A
